PrivacyPage.heroDesc: Committed to protecting your data absolutely.
PrivacyPage.privacyDescription: Committed to protecting personal data in accordance with Vietnamese law.
PrivacyPage.section1P1: When you book a consultation or register for a service, we collect: name, email, phone number, and business information (company name, industry).
PrivacyPage.section1P2: We do not store payment information — all transactions are processed through third-party payment gateways (VNPAY, MoMo, ZaloPay).
PrivacyPage.section2Item1: To deliver services you have registered for
PrivacyPage.section2Item3: To improve user experience on our website
PrivacyPage.section2Item4: To send updates about courses and events (with your consent)
PrivacyPage.section2P1: We do not sell, share or transfer personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.
PrivacyPage.section3Item1: Customer data: minimum 5 years per accounting regulations
PrivacyPage.section3Item2: Student data: retained while student has an account + 2 years after graduation
PrivacyPage.section3Item4: You have the right to request deletion of personal data at any time
PrivacyPage.section3P1: After the retention period, data is permanently deleted or anonymized.
PrivacyPage.section4P1: Data is encrypted with SSL/TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest.
PrivacyPage.section4P2: Only authorized personnel can access customer data.
PrivacyPage.section5Item1: Right to access — view your stored personal data
PrivacyPage.section5Item2: Right to correction — request correction of inaccurate information
PrivacyPage.section5Item3: Right to deletion — request account and data deletion
PrivacyPage.section5P1: Right to object — refuse data processing for marketing purposes
PrivacyPage.section5P2: Right to complaint — contact hello@loops.vn or relevant authorities
PrivacyPage.section6P1: Our website uses cookies to: remember your selected language, track login sessions, analyze traffic (anonymized Google Analytics).
PrivacyPage.section6P2: You can disable cookies in your browser — some features may be limited.
PrivacyPage.section7P1: We may update this policy over time. Significant changes will be notified by email 30 days before taking effect.
PrivacyPage.section8Item2: Address: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

TermsPage.heroDesc: Rights and responsibilities when using LOOP Solutions services.
TermsPage.termsDescription: Terms governing LOOP Solutions and customer rights and responsibilities.
TermsPage.section1P1: LOOP Solutions provides: website/app design & development, SEO services, hosting maintenance, online courses (Academy), and other digital services.
TermsPage.section1P2: Details of each service are specified in the contract/quotes signed between both parties.
TermsPage.section2Item1: Custom website/app: owned by the customer after full payment
TermsPage.section2Item2: Template website: customer has commercial usage rights, LOOP retains source code ownership
TermsPage.section2Item3: Course content: owned by LOOP Solutions
TermsPage.section2Item4: Internal tools: owned by LOOP Solutions
TermsPage.section2P1: Customers may not copy, distribute or use LOOP source code for external commercial purposes.
TermsPage.section3Item2: Custom projects: 50% on contract signing + 50% on delivery
TermsPage.section3Item3: Academy courses: payment before content access
TermsPage.section3P1: Late payment beyond 7 days: LOOP may suspend service. Late payment beyond 30 days: contract automatically terminates.
TermsPage.section4Item1: Template websites: 12-month free warranty (LOOP technical errors)
TermsPage.section4Item3: Post-warranty maintenance: charged monthly per service package
TermsPage.section4P1: Warranty does not cover: customer-caused errors, force majeure, scope change requests.
TermsPage.section5P1: LOOP ensures on-time delivery and quality as committed in the contract.
TermsPage.section5P2: Customers ensure timely provision of materials and feedback within 48 hours to avoid delays.
TermsPage.section6P1: Customers may cancel anytime with 7 days notice. Payment for completed work is non-refundable.
TermsPage.section6P2: LOOP may terminate if customer violates payment terms or provides illegal content.
TermsPage.section7P1: LOOP is not liable for: indirect damages, lost revenue, or lost profits due to customer delays.
TermsPage.section7P2: LOOP's liability shall not exceed 100% of the relevant contract/service value.
TermsPage.section8P1: All disputes are resolved through negotiation within 30 days.
TermsPage.section8P2: If no agreement is reached, disputes are resolved at Ho Chi Minh City People's Court.
TermsPage.section9Item1: LP (Learning Points) are internal reward points, not redeemable for cash
TermsPage.section9Item2: LP can be used to discount services (up to 20% of invoice)
TermsPage.section9P1: LOOP reserves the right to adjust LP exchange rates and policies without prior notice.
